# Coordinated publication

Build now follows the root [IC Tooling publication guide](../publishing.md).
There is one workspace release adapter and one explicit public-package roster.
The independent Build setup and release commands have been retired.

The original instructions remain in the imported history at
[Build 0.24.0](https://github.com/dragginzgame/ic-build/blob/c84c64e42a6bbbf06eba4490cf1cf6988caf5866/docs/publishing.md).
